name: salon-booking-bot-web
description: Vitrin frontend workspace (Phase 6). TWO apps, not one: `site` (public landing + widget + snippet) deploys to Vercel, `dashboard` (owner PII surface) deploys to our own server behind Cloudflare Access. They are separate packages ON PURPOSE — the strongest proof that the Airtable PAT and the PII read path never ship to Vercel is that the code is not there. A single app gated by an env flag would be security-by-flag, which is not security (ARCH-DEC, Phase 6 decision D-1).

engines.$comment: 22.18 not 22: flag-free TypeScript type-stripping and .ts import specifiers (used by @salon/shared and its node --test run) land in 22.18 / 23.6. On 22.0-22.5 this package does not run.
